evals.name: focus-work-4min
evals.prompt: Make me a deep focus track I can work to. Calm, steady, nothing distracting. Around 4 minutes.
evals.expected_output: A 'focus' style track of ~4 minutes (3:30-4:30), 72-100 BPM, soft steady pulse, very few lead notes, no crashes / risers, slow filter and layer movement in most sections, fades, mastered mp3 at -16 LUFS.
expectations: A song.json was delivered and uses the 'focus' style
The song builds with 0 harmony / spec problems
The mastered mp3 is 3:30-4:30 long
Mastered to -17..-15 LUFS with true peak <= -0.5 dBFS
Movement over time: at least half the sections (and 3+) use move / pump automation
Every section changes at least one thing from the section before it
No 4/8-bar loop plays on longer than the style allows (something changes every ~8 bars)
A reply with a timestamped section list was delivered (response.md)
Focus tempo 72-100 BPM
Nothing distracting: only soft grooves, no crashes or risers
Melody stays in the background (<= 24 lead notes per minute)
Fades in and out with master.level

evals.name: minimal-breakdown-5min
evals.prompt: I want a minimal techno track, around 5 minutes, hypnotic, with a proper breakdown in the middle.
evals.expected_output: A 'minimal' style track of ~5 minutes (4:30-5:30), 116-128 BPM, four-on-the-floor for most of the track, a kickless breakdown in the middle with the kick returning after it, pumping and filter moves, only a few distinct chords.
expectations: A song.json was delivered and uses the 'minimal' style
The song builds with 0 harmony / spec problems
The mastered mp3 is 4:30-5:30 long
Mastered to -17..-15 LUFS with true peak <= -0.5 dBFS
Movement over time: at least half the sections (and 3+) use move / pump automation
Every section changes at least one thing from the section before it
No 4/8-bar loop plays on longer than the style allows (something changes every ~8 bars)
A reply with a timestamped section list was delivered (response.md)
Minimal tempo 116-128 BPM
Four-on-the-floor kick for at least half the track
The groove (kick + bass) is there within 16 s - no long DJ intro
A breakdown (8+ bars without the kick) in the middle half, with the kick coming back
Sidechain-style pump used
Hypnotic harmony: at most 4 chord roots
